ps.text: Show the processes in your own terminal with `ps`.

ps-aux.text: List **all** the processes on the computer.

hitta.text: A process is eating up almost all of the CPU. Show the processes sorted by CPU usage so you can see what it's called.

bakgrund.hint: Put `&` at the end of the line.

kill-jobb.text: End the background job with `kill` and the job number (`%1`) or its PID.

server.text: The server `myserver` is running as root. Stop it – with `pkill` or `kill` and the right privileges.
server.hint: As a regular user you'll get "Operation not permitted". Put `sudo` in front.
